top_examples.hook: The daycare put my dog in an adoption parade before pickup. A volunteer called him abandoned while strangers lined up to take him home.
top_examples.premise: A pet daycare puts a paying client's dog in an adoption parade and tells the crowd he was abandoned while the owner is coming to collect him.
top_examples.title: The Adopt Me Sash at Pickup

top_examples.hook: My groom announced our wedding gifts had funded his startup. I learned about the company when he asked our guests to invest after the first dance.
top_examples.premise: A groom redirects the couple's cash wedding registry into his secret startup and asks reception guests to invest after the first dance.
top_examples.title: The Startup Pitch After Our First Dance

top_examples.hook: Dad grounded me by taking my wheelchair battery. I'm twenty-six, and he said I couldn't leave until I apologized.
top_examples.premise: A father confiscates his adult son's power-wheelchair battery to punish him for refusing to attend a dinner party.
top_examples.title: Dad Kept the Battery in His Cabinet

top_examples.hook: My sister printed my forgiveness in Dad's funeral program. She had stolen twelve thousand dollars from me, and everyone read that I had released her from the debt before I even arrived.
top_examples.premise: A sister prints in their father's funeral program that her sibling forgave the money she stole, even though no forgiveness was given.
top_examples.title: The Forgiveness Printed in Dad's Program

top_examples.hook: My groom withheld his daughter's wedding cake until she called me Mom. Then he made her hide the place card she'd drawn for her dead mother.
top_examples.premise: A groom withholds his daughter's wedding cake until she calls his new wife Mom, then demands that she hide the place card she made for her dead mother.
top_examples.title: The Place Card My Groom Wanted Hidden

weak_retention_examples.hook: My boss read my divorce papers at a team-building lunch. He offered a prize to whoever guessed which employee they belonged to.
weak_retention_examples.premise: A manager reads an employee's divorce documents at a team-building lunch and offers a prize for identifying the employee, after obtaining the documents for a benefits change.
weak_retention_examples.title: My Divorce Became the Lunch Game

weak_retention_examples.hook: My boss fired me for the company tattoo he paid for. He was still using my arm to recruit my replacement.
weak_retention_examples.premise: An employer fires a worker for the corporate tattoo he encouraged and paid for, while continuing to feature her arm in his recruitment campaign.
weak_retention_examples.title: The Tattoo on Their Hiring Banner

weak_retention_examples.hook: A stranger arrived to claim my husband's evenings. She'd won a month of home repairs, while I was home with our newborn.
weak_retention_examples.premise: A new father raffles away a month of evenings doing home repairs without telling his wife, who is already caring for their newborn without the help he promised.
weak_retention_examples.title: The Woman Who Won My Husband's Evenings

weak_retention_examples.hook: Our tour guide replaced the castle with his ex-wife's house. He said the bus wasn't leaving until she spoke to him.
weak_retention_examples.premise: A tour guide replaces a paid castle visit with a stop at his ex-wife's house and uses the bus passengers to pressure her into speaking to him.
weak_retention_examples.title: The Castle Tour That Stopped at His Ex's House

weak_retention_examples.hook: Our venue booked two weddings for the same aisle. Then the owner told me to make the other bride leave.
weak_retention_examples.premise: A venue books two weddings for the same chapel and hour, then pressures each bride to make the other leave instead of admitting its mistake.
weak_retention_examples.title: Two Brides at the Same Chapel Door
